name: cm-workspace
description: Change-management working tools. Currently: an RFP-to-proposal deck generator that plans a bid against the client's stated requirements and evaluation criteria, writes it from a curated knowledge bank, and audits the result for requirement coverage and content provenance; and a manday effort estimator that sizes a pursuit from scope drivers through a bottom-up hours library, with an open-ended judgement layer for adjustments the drivers alone don't capture.
